bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to employment; clarifying an employee's ability to waive a meal break; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 177.254, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 177.254, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5.

Meal break waiver.

(a) Notwithstanding subdivision 3, an employee may voluntarily waive a mandatory meal break required under this section. An employer must pay an employee for time worked during a meal break waived under this paragraph.

(b) A meal break waiver request:

(1) must be made to the employer electronically or in writing; and

(2) may be revoked by an employee for any shift where reasonable notice is provided to the employer.

(c) An employer must not require an employee to waive a meal break required under this section.
